title: Tracing the origin of elliptic curve seeds
text: Traces where the published seed values behind a standard family of elliptic curves came from, settling decades of speculation about whether the curves hide a backdoor.

title: Counterexample to Borsuk's conjecture
text: Builds a 321-point counterexample to Borsuk's conjecture in 63 dimensions after being asked to attack unsolved problems, then certifies it in exact arithmetic.

title: Solving a 370-year-old cryptogram
text: Works on an unsolved 370-year-old cryptogram of 64 numbers and recovers the hidden plaintext and the rule that produced it within a day.

title: Open ledger of historical cipher decipherments
text: Attempts to decipher unread historical ciphers drawn from archive catalogues, logging for each how the text was obtained or why nothing came out.

title: Statistical test of the Beale ciphers
text: Tests the Beale ciphers against reference statistics for genuine and fabricated text, concludes they are a hoax, and reconstructs how they were faked.

title: Analysis of who killed Maidan protesters
text: Weighs a court verdict, forensic findings and eyewitness evidence on who shot protesters in Kyiv on 20 February 2014 and writes a sourced analysis.

title: Forensic analysis of 2011 Mt. Gox code
text: Examines the 2011 Mt. Gox exchange source, leaked database dumps, server logs and commit history to reconstruct how the breach unfolded.

title: Candidate exoplanet from telescope light curves
text: Searches public telescope light curves for a periodic dip in one star's brightness and validates it as a candidate planet 3.75 times Earth's size.

title: Contradictions across a personal note vault
text: Reads two personal note vaults through a connector to surface contradictions between a writer's own stated beliefs, citing the specific notes involved.

title: Charged particle shape and electrophoretic motion
text: Works through the mathematics of how a charged particle's shape affects its motion in an electric field, producing derivations and figures for a journal paper.

title: Counterexample to the Jacobian conjecture
text: Searches for a counterexample to the Jacobian conjecture and finds a compact polynomial map showing it fails in three or more dimensions.

title: Weights in a social feed's open-sourced ranking code
text: Reads a social network's open-sourced recommendation code to work out how engagement signals are weighted and where the ranking favors controversy.

title: Whole-genome analysis of type 1 diabetes risk
text: Runs a personal whole-genome sequence through a variant-calling pipeline and interprets the variants in a written report on type 1 diabetes.

title: Raising a bound on zeta zeros
text: Combines published number-theory results to raise the known lower bound on the proportion of zeta zeros lying on the critical line from 41.6 to 67.2 percent.

title: Background of an Italian domain-blocking order
text: Researches why a 2020 Rome court order against pirate newspaper sites also blocked Project Gutenberg, tracing the case number, the 28 listed domains and its unresolved status.

title: Dossier mined from a decade of comments
text: Mines eleven thousand forum comments plus mailing list, Reddit and Stack Exchange posts into a dossier profiling the author's psychology, weaknesses and likely behavior.

title: Commit-history speed comparison
text: Compares a programming-language project's commit history before and after adopting automated code generation, concluding the author commits roughly eight times faster with features and fixes surging.

title: Year of hourly rainfall forecasts across cities
text: Pulls a year of hourly precipitation forecasts for several cities into CSV files and scripts an analysis that reports only the 60 to 80 percent expected values.

title: Wearable data links late coding to poor sleep
text: Connects wearable heart-rate-variability and sleep data to daily activity and finds that late-night coding sessions are degrading REM sleep and recovery.

title: Multiplicative complexity of Conway's Game of Life
text: Works out the multiplicative complexity of the Game of Life update rule, arrives at a value of seven, then confirms it with a week of SAT solver runs.

title: Best posting time for a forum submission
text: Analyzes about 180 days of public forum post engagement data to test the standard advice on best posting windows and reports where it falls short.

title: Consumer GPU memory growth rate
text: Gathers consumer graphics-card memory figures from 2015 to 2026 and estimates the median grew from 1-2 GB to about 8 GB, roughly doubling every five years.

title: Reconstructing university-era music
text: Reconstructs the music a person listened to at university and what would have played in the bars of the time, surfacing about 205 forgotten songs.

title: Hunting new reverse transcriptase families
text: Searches a large database of DNA sequences with hundreds of parallel agents for new reverse transcriptase families and flags candidates for wet-lab testing.

title: Recurring opening mistakes in chess games
text: Runs an engine over a player's own game history to score and rank positions that are repeatedly misplayed, then explains nine of them at the player's level.

title: How people seek personal guidance
text: Analyzes a random sample of one million conversations with a privacy-preserving tool to measure how often people seek personal guidance and how replies differ across life domains.

title: Theoretical physics calculation over two weeks
text: Works through a theoretical physics calculation under a physicist's supervision across more than 110 drafts, producing a paper in about two weeks.

title: Checking a hypothesis against prior studies
text: Collects studies from over two dozen platforms to cross-check whether a personal hypothesis has already been researched, mapping which of its parts are proven in theory or practice.

title: Naming a half-remembered childhood game
text: Identifies a Game Boy fighting game from a vague memory of one character's move in the attract-mode demo, naming both the game and the fighter.

title: Can prepaid credit legally expire in California
text: Checks whether California law lets a company expire prepaid credit after one year, reading the vendor's credit terms and relevant gift-certificate rules.

title: Strategic petroleum reserve drawdown limits
text: Researches how the pumping rate from a national petroleum reserve falls as stock drops below 300 million barrels, explaining why drawdown cannot simply be sped up.

title: Whether pirated books entered a training corpus
text: Researches how pirated books entered a public text corpus used to train language systems and what a later settlement paid per book.

title: Subexponential algorithm for 3-SAT
text: Derives a subexponential-time algorithm for 3-SAT in a 49-page paper and formalizes its two main theorems in Lean, refuting a long-standing complexity hypothesis.

title: Release-by-release bug rates in rsync
text: Compares bug rates of recent rsync releases against the project's historical distribution of releases to test whether machine-written commits increased defects.

title: Productivity gains from real conversations
text: Samples one hundred thousand real conversations and estimates how long each task would take with and without assistance, then extrapolates the labor productivity implications across the economy.

title: Upper bound for Bellman's lost-in-a-forest problem
text: Searches for a tighter upper bound on the shortest path guaranteed to escape a forest of known shape, the classic lost-in-a-forest problem.

title: Resolving a six-month physics roadblock
text: Works through a theoretical physics problem that had stalled a researcher for six months and reaches a resolution.

title: Developer sentiment across hundreds of forum comments
text: Classifies more than 500 scraped forum comments comparing two coding tools by sentiment and builds a dashboard showing what developers say about each.

title: What 968 side-project launches have in common
text: Parses 968 launch posts from a side-project forum and analyzes them for traits shared by the launches that drew more attention.

title: Nine years of health data for thyroid management
text: Reads 9.5 years of personal health records and wearable data to look for patterns that help manage a chronic thyroid disease.

title: How federal agencies use automated systems
text: Locates and consolidates each federal agency's published use-case inventory, spread across different pages and file formats, into one dataset for a news investigation.

title: County variation in mortgage lender concentration
text: Builds a mortgage market panel from public lending disclosure data to study how lender concentration varies across counties.
